Absolutely no UI, typography, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, mock phone frame or borders. Do not bake any glass card into the image. No rainbow swirls, glitter confetti, oversharpening or clipped white glare. Direction 1 / DEEP BLUE MILKY WAY. A breathtaking, broad silver-blue river of billions of stars sweeping diagonally from upper-right toward the lower-left across a truly immense midnight-navy cosmos. Dense detailed galactic dust lanes curve naturally through the stellar band, with deep indigo voids and subtle icy-blue starlight. A wide-angle feeling of looking into a boundless universe, no ground or horizon. Place the richest glowing star clouds mostly in the right side and lower half, retaining a balanced, spacious composition. Realistic restrained astrophotographic colors, clean navy-black and luminous silver, extraordinary fine detail.
